reviews.comment: This professor is fantastic! She's kind, knowledgeable, and very available at office hours and after class. Mid-term exams(3)-100 points, the final exam-150 points, and HW-50 points. The total is 500 points. Gives extra credit for attending lectures (1 or 2 pts occasionally for a total of ~10 points). Study the homework heavily on top of slides ;)
Dr. Li is the best professor ever! She is so caring and kind, and her lectures are fun! Taking this class with a different prof would be a mistake!

Personally, I didn't really need the textbook for this class. The majority of the information you need is really on her slides that she posts in Canvas! For the exams, if you study the homework and review the slides, you will be fine for the exams! I promise! Overall, she genuinely cares about what she teaches, and encourages cell biology learning!
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Li genuinely cares; I always would email her and she responds so quick. My biggest tip is to read the textbook because lecture is vague and unclear at times. Most of her slides are pictures, so read the textbook and take DETAILED notes from the textbook. Exams are just like the homework, with 10 new questions. Final is 30% and cumulative.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She is so kind and most of the exams have questions from the homework (which show you the correct anwsers and give you multiple attempts). She's awesome :)

My favorite professor so far. She is so caring, down to earth, funny, and genuinely is interested in your future. Dr. Li is extremely understanding and a lecture is very interesting. She gives out random extra credit for going. Study homework for the exam and you'll be fine. If you're confused on exam questions or concepts, go to her office hours!!

Professor Wanhe is literally such an amazing human being. She is so sweet and her class was very doable. Exams are not bad (study the homeworks), and she gives extra credit some days if you show up to class. So glad I took this class with her!

Dr. Li was a great prof! There was a lot of lecture material but if you study the powerpoints, look over the reviews, and focus on the homework, you should do great! She is really kind and always willing to help! She also gives extra credit and opportunities at improve your grade. Would definitely recommend taking her!

One of the sweetest, down-to-earth, and truly caring professors that I have had! Homeworks are what prepare you for the tests. Very open to office hours and any questions you may have. Show up to class! She makes it fun
